method.slo: p95 >1000 ms or failures/requests >0.10, sustained for three 1-second windows
method.persistence: 3 of last 5 flagged windows; 30-second re-alert cooldown
method.matching: one alert per incident, from 60 seconds before onset through 15 seconds after incident end
method.selection: joint model/policy validation: 0.65 early-warning recall + 0.35 precision; penalize false alarms above 0.5/healthy service-hour
method.development_history: v1 30000-series and v2 50000-series were inspected; v3 aligns incident matching to 60 seconds, reselects on validation and tests fresh 70000-series seeds

limitations: Synthetic data and simulator intervention assumptions
Declared topology and heuristic suspected cause, not causal proof
Calibrated model output is conditional on the synthetic distribution
Abrupt incidents can have no observable warning precursor
No production hospital, z/OS or accelerator validation
